claims: The Chicago Bulls waived Jaden Ivey on March 30, 2026.
The Chicago Bulls waived Jaden Ivey due to "conduct detrimental to the team".
The Chicago Bulls' waiver of Jaden Ivey followed controversial social media comments.
Jaden Ivey was in the final year of a 4-year, $32.9 million rookie contract.
Jaden Ivey originally signed his rookie contract with the Detroit Pistons in 2022.
The Detroit Pistons traded Jaden Ivey to the Chicago Bulls on February 3, 2026.
The Detroit Pistons traded Jaden Ivey to the Chicago Bulls in exchange for Kevin Huerter.
Jaden Ivey is a free agent going into the 2026 offseason.
Jaden Ivey's final salary for 2025-26 was $10,107,163.
Jaden Ivey's contract has a total value of $32,951,083 on the 4-year rookie scale.
Jaden Ivey will be a restricted free agent (RFA) in the 2026 offseason.
